notes.subject: יתיצב ... יתיצב
notes.rationale: the same verb repeated in the two halves of the antithesis — stand before kings / not stand before the dark — the mirror is kept

notes.subject: מהיר
notes.rationale: 'quick/speedy' vs 'diligent' vs 'skilful' — rendered फुरताल (quick) to keep the Hebrew's literal picture

notes.subject: अन्हार लोग
notes.rationale: חשכים is literally 'dark ones', an obscure-class figure; kept as 'अन्हार लोग' rather than 'mean/obscure men'

notes.subject: to the reader
notes.rationale: the verse opens with a direct question — 'की तूँ देखलिअ' — drawing the reader in

translation: की तूँ देखलिअ कोनो आदमी के जे अपन काम-काज में फुरताल? ऊ राजा सब के सोझा ठाढ़ होतइ; ओकरा अन्हार लोग के सोझा ठाढ़ नञ होतइ।
